notes: 25 products (zw-301 to zw-325). Categories: pouch 6, cup_bowl 8, paper_cup 1, frozen_tray 1, popcorn_bag 3, steam_bag 6 (Birds Eye 3, Green Giant 3). Brands: Ben's Original 3, Minute 2, Seeds of Change 2, Success 1, Idahoan 2, Bob Evans 1, Quaker 1, Nissin 1, Maruchan 1, Campbell's Soup on the Go 2, Pop Secret 3, Birds Eye 3, Green Giant 3.

Completeness: complete 5 (Idahoan Buttery Homestyle at 1100 W, Birds Eye Broccoli Florets and Mixed Vegetables, Green Giant Sweet Peas and Green Bean Casserole), partial 20, none 0, not_applicable 0. Most partials have full step lists but no wattage printed (rice pouches and cups, Bob Evans tray, Campbell's cups, Pop Secret), which the field convention counts as partial.

New optional fields used: microwave_instructions.quantity_variants [{units, time_s, time_s_max}] for labels that give a second time for 2 pouches or 2 cups (Ben's Original 2 pouches 2 1/2 min; Minute 2 cups 1 1/2 min); microwave_instructions.label_cautions; net_weight.per_unit_oz and units for multipacks; nutrition per_pouch / per_bag for dual-column labels; retailer_item_id as in products.json.

Container material found: Minute Ready to Serve cups are plastic #5 (polypropylene) and BPA free per the Minute FAQ, in recycled-paper sleeves. Nissin Cup Noodles is a double-wall fiber-based paper cup, 40% recycled fiber, PS-free, no plastic overwrap (inner coating not stated). BPA-free claims: Ben's Original pouches, Seeds of Change Brown Basmati pouch, Success boil-in-bag (also 'FDA-approved for food contact'). No pouch layer structure, bag polymer or popcorn-bag susceptor/PFAS statement was found for any product. Campbell's Soup on the Go label warns 'Metal edges are sharp' after the tab is peeled.

Do-not and handling rules useful for the app: Green Giant boxed pouches say do not cut a slit (heated sealed) while Ben's Original and Seeds of Change say tear 2 inches to vent and Minute says remove the film completely; Birds Eye says do not pierce and use stovetop below 800 W; Idahoan says do not reuse cup; Success says do not microwave multiple bags and the bag is cooked submerged in about 4 cups water; Pop Secret says never use the popcorn button and stop at 1-2 s between pops; Bob Evans targets 160°F.

Sources that worked this run: SmartLabel labelinsight (Birds Eye, Green Giant), preview.hannaford.com .html category URLs (worked for 5 fetches, then every request including robots.txt returned ROBOTS_DISALLOWED), Instacart storefronts (delivery.publix.com, milams.instacart.com) which carried full label directions, UberEats store listings (Albertsons, Meijer), Safeway /shop/pd/ (only with the correct numeric ID; a guessed ID returned an unrelated wine), H-E-B, ShopRite (UPC in URL), Wegmans, and brand pages popsecret.com, idahoan.com, quakeroats.com, minuterice.com/faqs/other, successrice.com/faqs/cooking, birdseye.com/faq. Failed: bensoriginal.com, campbells.com, greengiant.com, bobevansgrocery.com, oreida.com (robots), heb.com search, Hannaford/Stop & Shop/Food Lion/Giant/Martin's main sites (maintenance).

Not covered: Progresso microwavable soup bowls (search found only canned Progresso, no current microwavable bowl listing), Velveeta or Kraft Mac & Cheese cups in non-Original flavors and Ore-Ida Steam n' Mash (Kraft Heinz pages not reachable, oreida.com blocked, UPCs unknown), Bob Evans macaroni & cheese, Maruchan Bowl Chicken Flavor and Nissin Big Cup (no readable directions; no evidence found that Big Cup moved to the microwavable paper cup). The shared WebSearch quota ran out late in the run, so these were not searched further.

Nissin history: a 2015 trade article already called the then-new Cup Noodles 'microwavable' (2 1/2 min); the 2024 change replaced polystyrene with the paper cup (2 min 15 s). Older stock may differ. zw-017 (Chicken, already in products.json) uses cup_bowl for the same paper cup; zw-313 uses the new paper_cup category, so one of them should be aligned.

Conflicts flagged rather than resolved: Birds Eye Mixed Vegetables (ShopRite marketing 4-4 1/2 min vs label 5/5 1/2/6 min), Birds Eye Broccoli Florets (ShopRite 4 min vs label 4 1/2/5/6 min), Seeds of Change Quinoa & Brown Rice with Garlic nutrition (Instacart vs H-E-B), Success nutrition (H-E-B vs Instacart), Green Giant Antioxidant Blend 1000 W row garbled.

No UPC was computed. UPCs come from SmartLabel (Birds Eye Broccoli Florets, Green Giant Sweet Peas, Green Bean Casserole) or ShopRite/ACME item IDs with the two leading zeros dropped (Ben's Original Original, Seeds of Change Brown Basmati, Bob Evans, Birds Eye Mixed Vegetables, Green Giant Antioxidant Blend, Campbell's Chicken & Mini Round Noodles).
